    Set Active Loaded Scene node

    Set Active Loaded Scene calls SceneManager.SetActiveScene for a scene that is already loaded.

    Set Scene Name to a loaded scene's name or path. This node does not load the scene. If no valid loaded scene matches, or Unity refuses to make it active, UITK Navigation writes a warning and leaves the current active scene unchanged.

    The Enter port requires exactly one incoming transition or continuing Action. Next can be empty to end the chain or can connect to one UI or Action. Like other Scene Actions, continuation is immediate.

    This node is most useful after an Additive load when newly instantiated GameObjects should belong to the added scene or when scene-local systems depend on SceneManager.GetActiveScene().

    Tip

    Because Load Scene does not wait before following Next, do not connect Load Scene → Set Active Loaded Scene and assume the load has completed. Coordinate completion in code before requesting the route that activates the scene.
